finding.title: The successor UPDATE cannot queue on the uncommitted verification lease
finding.rationale: Source118 fixes the lazy-promise issue recorded under IG-ADHERENCE114F-01, but the contender still requires instagram_operation_lease_token IS NOT NULL. authorize() finishes with the committed binding lease cleared. resourceCommitBarrier then holds verification's new lease at deferred COMMIT. Under READ COMMITTED, the contender sees the preceding committed NULL token and excludes that row before attempting its row lock. It therefore returns zero instead of becoming the UPDATE waiter required by waitForResourceWaiter. The revised test still cannot establish successor preservation. This is a static harness defect, not an observed API116 result or evidence of a production fencing regression.
finding.suggested_action: Queue the real contender using the immutable identity and established owner tuple without filtering on the uncommitted lease value. Assert the initial cleared lease, observe the actual blocking relationship before releasing COMMIT, then retain the exact successor-token, affected-row, zero-HTTP and cleanup assertions. Execute both expiry branches and the live control.
